title: Roman numeral value
prompt: Each element of the input is the value of one Roman numeral symbol (I = 1, V = 5, X = 10, L = 50, C = 100, D = 500, M = 1000), and the list spells a valid standard Roman numeral from left to right (a number from 1 to 3999, using the subtractive forms IV, IX, XL, XC, CD and CM). Return the number it denotes: a symbol is subtracted when the symbol immediately after it is larger, and added otherwise. The empty list denotes 0.
